ItemID: NA; Title: Night Castle; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Symphonic rock feels less suited to my recent blues and roots listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Pop ballads are not what I am looking for right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Tom Petty feels like a natural next listen after You Should Be So Lucky; I would choose this first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its rootsy songwriting fits the mood of my recent listening; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country and roots direction appeals, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: What About Now; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Arena rock is less appealing right now than the bluesier records in my history.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: McCartney's melodic rock interests me, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing Ovation: The Greatest Songs from the Stage; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Stage-song interpretations do not match my current listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nathaniel Rateliff & The Night Sweats; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soul and roots sound could fit, but I would stick with my strongest picks this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Carter Girl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country material could appeal alongside Blown Away, but I am not drawn enough to choose it today.
